summary_rationale: AvePoint has executed a durable transformation from on-premises SharePoint tools into an 80% SaaS data protection and AI governance platform ($495.1M ARR in Q3 2026, +25% FX-adjusted, second straight quarter of acceleration), combining 90% FX-adjusted gross retention, 111% net retention, 10% TTM GAAP operating margins, 18-19% reported FCF margins (~11% ex-SBC FCF margin), and a debt-free $418.3M cash balance sheet plus an undrawn $100M JPMorgan revolver that funded $141.3M in 9M 2026 buybacks (-5.0M net shares). Key watch items from the Pass 1 blind-spot audit are >90% Microsoft dependency amid Microsoft's Nov 2026 Agent 365 control-plane launch, +35.8% YoY cloud hosting cost acceleration backed by $317.4M in non-cancellable IT commitments, negative Services gross margins (-2.0% Q3) and S&M investment compressing Q3 Non-GAAP operating margin by 520 bps YoY to 16.8%, -$7.4M operating sensitivity to 10% USD strength, and CLO Brian Brown's 280,000-share Jul-Oct 2026 10b5-1 sales under a plan inadvertently omitted from the FY2025 10-K.
